listing.name: Disco.Balls 1.1.c - More Lamp Colour Options
listing.aiSummary: Adds more color options to orbital lamps and lets them play disco music.

description:
More orbital lamp colour options.

Adds the option to make your lamp play Carameldansen and go disco, and adds more colours to the selection. This is a thinly veiled meme.

discordPostHtml:
Adds the option to make your lamp play Carameldansen and go disco, and adds more colours to the selection.

This is a thinly veiled meme.

Known issue: Loading a save while the song is playing makes it play twice (and twice as loud). This is a feature and will not be fixed.

Changelog:
1.1.c
Adjusted - Made the number bigger
1.1.b
Adjusted - Version number change (how creative!)
1.0.a
Added - Kantas Lamp now goes hard like it should
Fixed - No longer picks the same colour twice in a row
+ Save compatible + 
+ Can be installed on an ongoing save
This means: The mod can safely be added if it was not present on game start, and can be installed over any prior updates of the same mod.
